$comment: Game-varying facts live here, NOT in the instrument profile: process names and risk framing change on a different cadence from the instrument's key layout, and a second instrument in the same game must not duplicate them.
antiCheat: Tencent ACE (kernel level, disclosed on the Steam store page)

prohibitedSoftwareNotice.zh-Hans: 腾讯官方《禁止/不建议使用的软硬件列表》同时点名「按键精灵、Autohotkey、键盘鼠标控制切换器、幽灵键鼠、大漠外挂程序、python 等自动脚本」与「鼠标宏」；Garena 版公告并列出「硬件宏」。本工具的两种模式都在禁止范围内。宏导出只是在检测层面更安静，不是政策上的安全港。
prohibitedSoftwareNotice.en: Tencent's official prohibited-software list names both automation scripts (AutoHotkey, python) AND mouse macros; the Garena announcement also lists hardware macros. BOTH of this tool's modes fall inside that prohibition. Macro export is quieter in detection terms only - it is not a policy safe harbour.
